purpose: Prevent material-price narratives from being treated as causal issuer signals before exposure and pass-through are proven.

LOW_OR_NO_EXPOSURE_CONTROL.definition: Issuer in same broad industry/theme/time regime but tested material is not a direct economically meaningful input under the contemporaneous production-route vintage, or exposure evidence is explicitly low.
LOW_OR_NO_EXPOSURE_CONTROL.forbidden: UNKNOWN exposure cannot be relabeled no exposure.

FAILED_PASS_THROUGH_CONTROL.definition: Direct input exposure is established and input pressure/repricing narrative exists, but realized margin capture is absent, adverse, or remains unproven after the preregistered reporting clock.
guards: announced price increase is not realized ASP
realized ASP increase is not margin capture
UNKNOWN margin bridge is not failure

outcomes: D1/D3/D5 residual return only after PIT eligibility
margin/volume confirmation on their native reporting clocks
falsifyIf: effect also appears in low/no-exposure controls
one date or one mega-cap dominates
lag choice only works after outcome search
increment is redundant with sector RS/market regime/price trend

maturity: No further promotion. D10-09 stays L2; D10-12 L3 is data-feasibility only.
next: Build prospective immutable receipts on independent dates; do not fabricate historical Shadow.
